items.title: Iqbal Emon turns hero as Bangladesh A reach semis with one-wicket win
items.summary: Iqbal Hossain Emon produced late bating heroics as Bangladesh A secured a nail-biting one-wicket victory over Afghanistan A at the West End Park International Cricket Stadium in Doha on Saturday to book their place in the semifinals of the Asia Cup Rising Stars tournament.

items.title: Mushfiqur Rahim ruled out of Centurion Test because of groin injury
items.summary: He is the latest Bangladesh player ruled out of the second Test, after in-form fast bowler Hasan Mahmud was deemed unavailable because of an elbow injury

items.title: Injury-hit Bangladesh lose Mushfiqur ahead of second Test
items.summary: Mushfiqur's injury adds to Bangladesh's growing concerns ahead of the second Test, following the earlier loss of pace bowler Hasan Mahmud.

items.title: Injured Hasan Mahmud ruled out of South Africa tour

items.title: Ngidi back from injury for Bangladesh ODIs; Maharaj to lead SA
items.summary: Anrich Nortje, who has not played an ODI since before the 2023 ODI World Cup, is also back and is also expected to be fit for the second Test
